message.content: A cell that contains more than one nucleus is often referred to as a **syncytium** (plural: syncytia). Syncytia can arise naturally—such as the multinucleated muscle fibers formed from fused myoblasts—or as a result of viral infection, where the virus induces the fusion of infected cells into a multinucleated giant cell.
